31.text: DOMESTICATION OF THE DOG. — The domestication of the dog in north-

32.text: eastern Asia surely preceded by a considerable period of time its adoption for

33.text: carrying-purposes. Lamut dogs, for instance, are now used exclusively for

34.text: hunting-pursuits. They scent squirrels and sables in the woods, overtake elk

35.text: and reindeer on the hard-crusted snow in the spring-time, and catch white and

36.text: red foxes on the open plain. Notwithstanding their fleetness, they are not

37.text: well fitted for driving, on account of their roaming disposition. On the other

38.text: hand, some European dogs, bought by Kamchatka drivers from merchant-ships,

39.text: prove to be well adapted for the harness, and are able to keep pace with the

40.text: native team, at least for short distances.
